verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine or automation builder in Quo that maps events to actions. Webhooks (message, call, summary and transcript events) are developer building blocks that send events out for external code to act on. Call routing, ring orders and phone menus are adjacent call-flow settings, not general event-to-action rules, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
